name: Warm Villa
desc: Warm Villa: cosy, calm, and free to enjoy what is beautiful.
descZh: 暖居别墅，温馨、平静，自由地感受美好

keyboard.actionZh: 行走 / 驾驶；A/D 转向

keyboard.action: Follow the nearby prompt: use, feed, sit, lie or leave
keyboard.actionZh: 按附近提示互动、投喂、入座、躺下或离开

touch.action: Left stick: walk/drive; right drag: look
touch.actionZh: 左杆行走/驾驶，右侧拖动环顾

touch.action: Use follows the nearby prompt; Exit leaves your seat or activity
touch.actionZh: 点互动执行附近提示；点离开退出座位或玩法

notes.text: Play starts automatically. Practice scores stay in this game and are not uploaded to a leaderboard.
notes.textZh: 进入后自动开始。练习成绩只留在当前游戏，不上传排行榜。

keyboard.action: Free the cursor / close the map or terminal
keyboard.actionZh: 释放光标 / 关闭导览图或终端

touch.action: Crouch and Jump buttons remain beside Use
touch.actionZh: 互动旁保留蹲下与跳跃按钮

notes.text: Click the Villa scene to capture the mouse; Esc releases it. Browser fullscreen remains F11, with no in-game fullscreen action.
notes.textZh: 点击别墅画面捕获鼠标，Esc 释放；全屏由浏览器 F11 管理，游戏不提供全屏操作。

sections.title: Map, smart home and menu
sections.titleZh: 导览图、智能家居与菜单

keyboard.actionZh: 打开 / 关闭智能终端
切换白天 / 傍晚 / 夜晚

keyboard.action: Return to the entrance and stop the vehicle

keyboard.actionZh: 展开 / 收起统一操作指南

keyboard.action: Select a floor while the map is open

touch.action: Tap the location badge for the map, including in immersive mode
touch.actionZh: 点位置信息打开导览图，沉浸模式下也可使用
点终端打开智能家居控制

touch.action: The game menu contains Return to entrance and Immersive mode; ? opens this guide
touch.actionZh: 游戏菜单内可回到门口、切换沉浸模式；点 ? 打开本指南

touch.action: Map tabs select floors or the estate; × or the backdrop closes the map or terminal
touch.actionZh: 导览图页签选择楼层或庭院；点 × 或背景关闭导览图或终端

notes.text: Terminal pages control room/all lights, fireplace, aquarium lighting, gradual time/weather changes, one selected live camera, look sensitivity and snooker guides. Opening the map or terminal leaves immersive mode.
notes.textZh: 终端各页可调房间/全部灯光、壁炉、鱼缸灯、渐变昼夜天气、单路实时监控、视角灵敏度和台球辅助线。打开导览图或终端会退出沉浸模式。

notes.text: In an older or isolated host without game-menu actions, Return to entrance and Immersive mode are in Terminal → Settings.
notes.textZh: 若旧版或独立运行环境没有游戏菜单操作，可在终端 → 设置内回到门口、进入沉浸模式。

keyboard.action: Carry/place the camping chair; contextual door, screen input or computer power
keyboard.actionZh: 搬放露营椅；按场景操作车门、大屏信号或电脑电源

touch.action: Use operates fixtures, brews/drinks tea, feeds pets, opens wardrobes, sits/lies down or uses the swing
touch.actionZh: 点互动使用设备、泡茶喝茶、投喂、开合衣柜、坐下躺下或坐秋千

touch.action: Nearby Carry/Place, Door, Input and Power buttons provide secondary actions
touch.actionZh: 附近的搬起/放下、车门、信号与电源按钮执行辅助操作

notes.text: Tea starts empty: brew gradually, wait for a full cup, then drink it. Busy actions do not restart the cycle. Each pet has its own food and cooldown. Camping chairs can be placed on clear ground.
notes.textZh: 茶杯初始为空：逐渐冲泡，满杯等待，再饮用至空；忙碌时重复操作不重置。每只小动物的食物和冷却独立。露营椅需放在空地。

keyboard.action: Accelerate / brake first, then reverse when stopped
keyboard.actionZh: 前进 / 先刹停再倒车

keyboard.action: Safely reset the current vehicle / rally practice
keyboard.actionZh: 安全复位当前车辆 / 拉力练习

touch.action: Stick forward accelerates; back brakes then reverses; left/right steers
touch.actionZh: 推杆向前加速，向后先刹停再倒车，左右转向

touch.action: Reset safely resets; Use enters and Exit leaves when stopped
touch.actionZh: 点复位安全重置；点互动上车，停稳后点离开下车

notes.text: Sedan, pickup and scooter can reverse after stopping. The rally rig only brakes, with no reverse. Stop completely before opening road-vehicle doors or getting out.
notes.textZh: 轿车、皮卡与电动车刹停后可倒车；拉力模拟器仅刹车，不倒车。完全停稳后才能打开车辆车门或下车。

keyboard.action: Select a floor inside the cabin

touch.action: Use calls the elevator; inside, tap a floor or Open/Close
touch.actionZh: 点互动呼叫电梯；进入后点楼层或开门/关门

notes.text: The highest floor is listed first. An empty car closes its doors after four seconds.
notes.textZh: 高楼层层级在上。空轿厢四秒后关门。

touch.action: Drag to aim / adjust power, or hold the aim arrows and −/+ targets
touch.actionZh: 拖动瞄准/调力度，或按住瞄准箭头和 −/+ 按钮

touch.action: Shot shoots, Reset racks again, Exit leaves the table
touch.actionZh: 点击球出杆，点重摆开新局，点离开退出球桌
